sections.title: Proof of the Pach-Tardos conjecture
sections.abstract: The authors state that every acyclic matrix pattern has Ex(n,P) ≤ n^{1+O_P(1/log log n)}.
sections.claimed_result: The authors state that every acyclic matrix pattern has Ex(n,P) ≤ n^{1+O_P(1/log log n)}.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Extremal functions for acyclic matrix patterns; the O-term may depend on P.
sections.caveat: New unrefereed preprint; proof details and sharpness need expert review.

sections.title: A counterexample to the quantum Hedetniemi conjecture
sections.abstract: Explicit graphs satisfy χ(G×H) ≤ 1538 < 1539 = min(χ_q(G),χ_q(H)), with failures for several variants.
sections.claimed_result: Explicit graphs satisfy χ(G×H) ≤ 1538 < 1539 = min(χ_q(G),χ_q(H)), with failures for several variants.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Finite graphs, categorical products, projection-valued quantum colorings, and nonzero unital C*-algebras.
sections.caveat: Preprint claim; graph constructions and Lean certificates remain to be independently checked.

sections.title: Universal completeness of exponentials
sections.abstract: Constructs universal exponential systems at density one and density v under the stated L^p and measure thresholds, and reports sharpness of α>1/2.
sections.claimed_result: Constructs universal exponential systems at density one and density v under the stated L^p and measure thresholds, and reports sharpness of α>1/2.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Uniformly discrete frequency sets in R; 1≤p<∞ and measurable sets below the density threshold.
sections.caveat: Abstract-level summary; Lean code availability is reported but not audited.

sections.title: Stationary varifolds with singularities II
sections.abstract: For every m≥3, constructs a stationary integral varifold with a multiplicity-two flat tangent plane, smoothness off one point, and infinite local topology.
sections.claimed_result: For every m≥3, constructs a stationary integral varifold with a multiplicity-two flat tangent plane, smoothness off one point, and infinite local topology.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Smooth ambient Riemannian metric; integral m-varifold stationary in an open set.
sections.caveat: The abstract reports correction of an earlier error; the construction needs independent review.

sections.title: Markovian renormalisation for percolation in high-dimension: Semi-decidability of mean field behavior
sections.abstract: Develops a Markov-chain renormalisation approach for d>6 and claims asymptotics, a local CLT, and semi-decidability of critical mean-field behavior.
sections.claimed_result: Develops a Markov-chain renormalisation approach for d>6 and claims asymptotics, a local CLT, and semi-decidability of critical mean-field behavior.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Bernoulli percolation in dimensions d>6, with p approaching p_c from below.
sections.caveat: Long high-dimensional preprint; practical effectiveness and proof verification remain open.
